run.metric_desc.edge_build: How quickly you change edges and how well you maintain the edge angle. A high score means the new edge builds quickly and progressively.
run.metric_desc.edging_similarity: Edge angle pattern similarity between toeside and heelside. A smaller gap means more balanced edge engagement.
run.metric_desc.edging_smoothness: How smoothly the edge angle changes. A high score means the board forms one continuous curve as it moves from flat to edged and then releases again.
run.metric_desc.g_force: The centrifugal force experienced through the turn. A high score means greater centrifugal force is generated in the turn.
run.metric_desc.heel_similarity: Measures the consistency of edging across heelside turns. A higher score means more similar curve shapes and fluctuations from turn to turn.
run.metric_desc.pressure_score: How stable and fluid your pressure application and release are through the turn. A high score means the pressure is continuous, focused, and repeatable.
run.metric_desc.radius_consistency: How similar the turn radii are between toeside and heelside. A smaller difference means more symmetrical S-turns and less drift toward one side of the run.
run.metric_desc.rhythm_score: How consistent your rhythm is from turn to turn. A high score means the duration and size of consecutive turns remain stable.
run.metric_desc.rotation_rate: The average rate at which the board changes direction through a turn. A high score means the rotation rate matches the target turn shape and remains even throughout the turn.
run.metric_desc.turn_closure: How closed the turn is. A high score means the board travels farther across the fall line at turn exit.
run.metric_desc.turn_shape: Whether your turns are round and full. A high score means the board changes direction continuously and evenly from entry to exit, creating a clean C-shaped arc.
run.metric_desc.toe_similarity: Measures the consistency of edging across toeside turns. A higher score means more similar curve shapes and fluctuations from turn to turn.
run.metric_desc.velocity_consistency: Speed similarity between toeside and heelside. A large gap reveals significantly weaker control on one side.
run.metric_desc.weight_release: How fully you release pressure when changing edges. A high score means pressure from the previous turn is released promptly and smoothly, with a strong reduction in load.
run.pressure_hint: Measures the stability and smoothness of pressure control through the turn.
run.segment_ai_diagnosis_fallback: Your upper body is leading the edge transition.
run.segment_ai_next_run_fallback: Finish the turn, count 1-2-3, then initiate.
run.skill_earlier_edge_change_focus: Look earlier toward the next arc you want to enter.
run.skill_earlier_edge_change_upper_body: Keep the upper body quiet and avoid rotating the shoulders first.
run.skill_higher_turn_finish: Finish the turn with more height
run.skill_higher_turn_finish_focus: Keep your eyes moving toward the exit of the turn.
run.skill_higher_turn_finish_upper_body: Stay tall through the torso and avoid collapsing late in the turn.
run.symmetry_hint: Compares toeside and heelside similarity — the closer, the better.
run.timing_hint: Controls when you engage the new edge, apply pressure, and exit the arc each turn.
run.track_unavailable: No GPS track for this run
run.turn_shape_empty_hint: Not enough valid turns, or the algorithm hasn't generated a representative curve yet
